Request for Proposal (RFP)
Design, Development and Deployment of a Digital Case Management
Platform for the Regional Public Health Directorate
RFP Reference: RPHD/IT/2026-014
1. Introduction and Background
The Regional Public Health Directorate (RPHD) is seeking proposals from qualified firms to design,
develop, and deploy a Digital Case Management Platform (“the Platform”) to replace its current
paper-based and spreadsheet-based case tracking processes across 12 regional health centers.
2. Scope of Work
The selected firm will be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of the Platform, including requirements
gathering, system architecture, development of a secure web application and companion mobile app,
integration with the NHIE API, data migration, UAT, staff training, and 12 months of post-launch
support.
3. Timeline and Key Dates
MilestoneDate
RFP Issued27 July 2026
Proposal Submission Deadline31 August 2026, 17:00 (local time)
Contract Award5 October 2026
4. Indicative Budget
The total available budget for this engagement is USD 380,000, inclusive of development, integration,
training, and the 12-month support period.
5. Evaluation Criteria
Proposals will be evaluated using the Quality and Cost-Based Selection (QCBS) method, with a 75%
weighting on technical quality and 25% on financial proposal.
